description_md: Trailing alphanumeric code extracted from source `studyName` (e.g. '33RR' from '2004-11-02-C-33RR'); input to `derive_cruise_key_on_casts()`.
Cruise natural key (YYYY-MM-NODC); FK to `cruise`. Derived via `calcofi4db::derive_cruise_key_on_casts()` against `ship_code` + `datetime_utc`.
CalCOFI station key 'LLL.L SSS.S', derived as `sprintf('%05.1f %05.1f', line, station)` from the source's own Line/Station columns.
CalCOFI grid cell; FK to `grid`. Derived via `assign_grid_key()`.
